info.title: Launchpoint Public API
info.description:
REST API for Launchpoint brands and agencies. Authenticate with an API key in the `x-api-key` header.

## Requirements
- Public API access must be enabled for the company.
- The company must have money in its Launchpoint wallet or a saved payment method. Otherwise requests return `402 { "error": "Active subscription required" }`.
- Create and manage API keys in Dashboard → Settings → API.

## Rate limits
- Default: **100 requests per minute** per API key.
- Approved partner accounts: **400 requests per minute**.
- Every response includes `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Requests over the limit return `429`.

## Errors
- Errors use `{ "error": "<message>" }` with the matching HTTP status. Some endpoints also include a `code`.

## Timestamps
- Timestamps are Unix timestamps in milliseconds unless a field says otherwise.

## Pagination
- Most list endpoints accept `page` and `limit` and return `{ data, page, total }`. Some also return `totalPages`.
- `scope=company` is the default. A parent agency key can pass `scope=agency` on supported routes to include its own data and linked brands.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: Payout history, balances, and pending creator money

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: API key from Dashboard → Settings → API

ScopeParam.name: scope
ScopeParam.description: Data scope. `company` (default) returns only the API key company's data. `agency` returns the parent agency plus its linked brands. `scope=agency` requires a parent agency key; other keys receive `403`.

get.description:
Retrieve all programs for your company with pagination and filtering.

Programs represent campaigns or marketing initiatives that creators participate in.

Retrieve social media posts with comprehensive filtering options.

Posts can be filtered by program, platform, creator, date range, and more.
Results include engagement metrics (views, likes, comments, etc.)

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to list posts across the parent
agency and every subaccount in one call.

Retrieve detailed information about a specific post/video.

Includes metrics, engagement data, payment status, and related contract/program information.

contract.description: Contract details, or null when the post creator has no offer-level contract.

get.description:
Retrieve historical daily metrics data for a specific post/video over time.

Shows how views, likes, comments, and other metrics have evolved day-by-day.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of history to retrieve (0 for all)

history.description: Daily snapshots in chronological order (oldest to newest)

post.description:
Generate and download a CSV export of posts.

The response is a streaming CSV file with all post data including metrics.

selectedIds.description: Specific post IDs to export (overrides filters)

get.description:
Retrieve key performance indicators with status breakdowns.

Includes metrics for:
- Programs (by status: active, draft, paused, etc.)
- Contracts (by status: active, pending, completed, etc.)
- Posts (total, views, engagement, paid/unpaid)
- Creators (total, with active contracts)

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to compute KPIs across the
parent agency and every subaccount.

get.summary: List all tracked videos with analytics
get.description:
Retrieve all tracked videos/posts with comprehensive analytics and filtering.

Includes engagement metrics, sorting, and detailed statistics for each video.

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to aggregate tracked videos
across the parent agency and every subaccount.

Retrieve all tracked social media accounts with aggregated analytics.

Groups posts by social media handle and platform, providing comprehensive metrics per account.

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to aggregate accounts across the
parent agency and every subaccount.

Get comprehensive analytics with filtering capabilities.

Similar to the /overall page in the web app, this endpoint provides:
- Summary metrics
- Top performing posts
- Top performing creators
- Platform breakdown

When `fromDate` and/or `toDate` are provided, `summary` uses the same
activity attribution model as the dashboard Performance Overview chart:
- daily deltas from post `daily` stats
- first-stat totals attributed back to the upload date
- posts without daily stats attributed to their upload date

`snapshotSummary`, `topPosts`, `topCreators`, and `platformBreakdown`
remain upload-date snapshot views, matching the `/overall` page tables.

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to compute the overview across
the parent agency and every subaccount.

snapshotSummary.description: Legacy upload-date snapshot totals for the same filters

topPosts.description: Top 10 posts by snapshot views for posts uploaded in the selected range

topCreators.description: Top 10 creators by snapshot views for posts uploaded in the selected range

platformBreakdown.description: Snapshot metrics grouped by platform for posts uploaded in the selected range

get.description:
Retrieve daily counts for recruitment invites sent and candidate responses received.

Date buckets are UTC days in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Agency accounts can pass `scope=agency` to aggregate recruitment
outreach across the parent agency and every subaccount.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). Defaults to 29 days before `toDate`.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). Defaults to today.

responseRate.description: Responses divided by invites sent, expressed as a percentage

date.description: UTC date bucket in YYYY-MM-DD format

400.description: Invalid date range or date format

post.description:
Generate a shareable invite link for a program.

Creators who use this link can join the program directly.

expiresInDays.description: Days until link expires (null for never, max 90)

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times link can be used (null for unlimited)

get.description:
Read-only access to your company's wallet ledger entries.

Shows all credits and debits to your wallet including:
- Payouts to creators
- Adjustments
- Refunds

**Note:** Executing payouts via API is not supported for security reasons.

amount.description: Transaction amount in dollars (negative for debits)

totalCredits.description: Sum of all credits in dollars

totalDebits.description: Sum of all debits in dollars (absolute value)

get.description:
Read-only summary of your company's payout wallet balances and lifetime activity.

Returns the same metrics shown on the payouts dashboard:
- **Available balance** — funds ready to pay creators
- **Pending balance** — incoming top-ups still processing
- **Total owed** — calculated amount owed across active contracts
- **Lifetime deposits** — total confirmed wallet top-ups
- **Lifetime paid out** — total confirmed payouts to creators

All amounts are in USD dollars.

totalOwed.description: Total amount owed to creators across active contracts in dollars

lifetimeDeposits.description: Lifetime confirmed wallet deposits in dollars

lifetimePaidOut.description: Lifetime confirmed payouts to creators in dollars

get.description:
Retrieve list of pending payouts for active contracts.

Includes detailed payment calculations, pro-rata adjustments, and creator information.
Shows payouts that are due, overdue, or upcoming based on contract schedules.

parameters.name: minAmount
parameters.description: Minimum payout amount in dollars, with at most two decimal places

get.description:
Retrieve creators associated with your company, including their email and a per-campaign
contract status map. Use this to determine which creators are active across your campaigns.

Each creator includes a `campaigns` array showing every program they are (or were) contracted
under, along with the contract status. A creator's top-level `status` is `"active"` if they
have at least one active contract, otherwise `"inactive"`.

Ghost-handle contracts are excluded.

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: Filter to creators with a contract in this program

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by creator name or email

status.description: "active" if the creator has at least one active contract

handles.description: Social media handles associated with this contract

get.description:
List the creator collections (saved account groups) for the
authenticated company.

Retrieve creator contracts with sensitive payment details hidden.

Contracts define the relationship between your company and creators.
Includes metadata only - no payment execution capabilities via API.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, active, completed, declined, cancelled)

expiresAt.description: Contract end time in Unix milliseconds, or null when the contract is ongoing.
